name: inactive-fold-chevron-align
description: rail: the 'Inactive subagents (N)' fold's chevron gutter must be left-justified at exactly the parent session label's x, for a dotted (signal) parent and a quiet one alike

mutation.declaration: Rail.module.css: .inactiveFold { padding-left: calc(var(--space-4) - 1px) } (quiet-parent branch, reverted to 0) and the :has(.signal) + [role=group] > [role=treeitem] > .inactiveFold override (dotted-parent branch, neutralized)
